run_release_docs: run release_docs.py with a version number to branch Google Test wiki pages for a new release
create_WikiBrancher: create a WikiBrancher instance with a dot version string to prepare wiki file branching for gtest or gmock
branch_WikiBrancher_BranchFiles: branch wiki files using WikiBrancher.BranchFiles to create SVN copies with a version prefix like V2_6_
update_WikiBrancher_UpdateLinksInBranche: update internal wiki links in branched files so they point to the versioned page names
use_DropWikiSuffix: use DropWikiSuffix to remove the .wiki suffix from a wiki filename string
